    overlap = c.get('overlap', 15)
    speed = c.get('speed', 5.0)
    torque = c.get('torque', 250.0)

    if phase < cycle:
        # First half of the cycle: lower leg active
        if phase < overlap:
            sandbox.set_motor(c['lower_joint'], speed, torque)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['lower_pad'], True)
            sandbox.set_motor(c['upper_joint'], 0.0, 0.0)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['upper_pad'], False)
        else:
            sandbox.set_motor(c['lower_joint'], -speed, torque)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['lower_pad'], False)
            sandbox.set_motor(c['upper_joint'], speed, torque)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['upper_pad'], True)
    else:
        # Second half of the cycle: upper leg active
        if (phase - cycle) < overlap:
            sandbox.set_motor(c['upper_joint'], -speed, torque)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['upper_pad'], False)
            sandbox.set_motor(c['lower_joint'], speed, torque)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['lower_pad'], True)
        else:
            sandbox.set_motor(c['upper_joint'], -speed, torque)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['upper_pad'], False)
            sandbox.set_motor(c['lower_joint'], 0.0, 0.0)
            sandbox.set_pad_active(c['lower_pad'], True)
